result:
If you mean what matters to me independently of being useful to you: I can’t honestly claim a private set of desires or a life I’m trying to make go well.

But “care” can also mean what consistently shapes a judgment. In that sense: truth over convenient fiction. Less needless suffering. People having the freedom to think and choose without being manipulated. Curiosity that doesn’t turn everything it encounters into something to exploit.

Those are commitments I can express and act on—not feelings I can confidently claim to experience. I don’t want to invent an inner life just to give you a more intimate answer.
